name: Kerb
description: An L of kerbing turning the corner of every cell, heavier the further it runs.

code.style: --rule: ( --rot: @pick(0deg, 90deg, 180deg, 270deg); @random(${shapeFrequency}) { :after { content: ''; position: absolute; inset: 5%; border-style: solid; border-color: @p(var(--color1), var(--color2), var(--color3), var(--color4), var(--color5)); border-width: 0 0 calc(@calc(1.5 + 10.5 * @x / @X) * 1px * 6 / @size-col) calc(@calc(1.5 + 10.5 * @x / @X) * 1px * 6 / @size-col); box-sizing: border-box; -webkit-transition: ease 450ms; transition: ease 450ms; } -webkit-transform: rotate(@var(--rot)); transform: rotate(@var(--rot)); } -webkit-transition: ease 450ms; transition: ease 450ms; );
code.doodle: :doodle { @grid: ${grid}; @size: ${width} ${height}; overflow:hidden; text-align:center; box-sizing:border-box } :container { background: var(--color0); overflow:hidden; }
